title: Enum field extraction answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for a Part 2 (or sort-block) enum menu field. The model returns one menu token plus a verbatim supporting quote, OR reports the paper silent (answered=false). Menu membership is enforced by the form-filler/domain gate; 'other' is always a legal escape (P3).

value.description: The chosen menu token, or null when answered=false.

quote.description: Verbatim span supporting the value; required when answered=true.
